messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Hi Chloe, it's Daniel from fellowship. Could you bring the crackers this Sunday? You're next on the snack rota.

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: oh yes! how many do i need

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: One big box is fine. About twenty of us usually.

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok my mum can buy it saturday

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Great. Also, we're putting prayer topics on the board. Is there anything you'd like on it? Only if you want to.

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: maybe my exams

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Sure, I'll write 'Chloe's exams'. Nothing else needed.

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: thanks

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: I'm making a group chat for the helpers and snack people so the rota is all in one place. I'll add you if your parents are okay with it.

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: i'll ask my mum tonight

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Good idea. And it's a surprise for Pastor's birthday on the 20th, so please don't mention it to Mei.

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: haha ok secret

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Chloe 你好，我係團契嘅 Daniel。今個主日輪到你帶小食喎，得唔得呀？

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 得呀！要帶幾多

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 一大盒餅乾就夠，平時大約有二十個人

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我星期六叫媽咪幫我買

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 好呀，多謝你。我哋禱告事項板度想寫啲代禱嘢，你有冇想寫？唔想都冇問題

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 寫我考試好喇

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 好，我寫咗『Chloe 考試』。其他唔洗寫

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 多謝

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 我哋開咗個導師同輪值嘅 group，方便睇排表。你爸媽同意嘅話我先加你入去

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我今晚問下佢哋

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 好呀。對啦，二十號係牧師生日，我哋想畀個驚喜，你唔好同阿 Mei 講喎

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 哈哈好，我唔講

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 多謝你，主日見

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 主日見

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Chloe，今個禮拜日輪到你帶 snack 呀，記得喎

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 記得呀！餅乾可以嗎

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 可以，一盒就夠。仲有你想唔想將你嘅 prayer topic 寫上 board？

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 寫 exam 啦

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: ok 冇問題。我哋 helper 開咗個 group 排 rota，你爸媽同意我先加你

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 好呀我問媽咪

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: sure。另外 pastor 廿號生日，係 surprise，唔好同 Mei 講

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: haha ok

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: thanks，星期日見

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Hi Sam, are you able to take the snack rota next week? Lily can't do it.

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: yeah no problem

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Thanks. Biscuits and some juice cartons, whatever's easy.

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok. do we need cups

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Cups are in the cupboard by the kitchen, third shelf.

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok got it

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: How did your maths test go, by the way? You mentioned it last week

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok i think. it was hard but i finished

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Good for you. I'll put it on the prayer board if you like.

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: sure thanks

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Honestly I find you easier to talk to than most of the kids at fellowship. Please don't mention that to the others

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: oh haha ok

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Anyway. Prayer topics this week, do you have any?

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: my grandma's been sick so maybe her

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: I'm sorry to hear that. I'll add her name. Is she in hospital?

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: no just home, shes tired a lot

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: I hope she feels better soon. Tell her we're thinking of her.

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: i will

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: And if you'd rather not have her on the board, just say

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: its ok you can put her

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Done. See you Sunday.

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: see you

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Sam，下個禮拜輪到你帶小食，Lily 做唔到，你得唔得？

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 得呀冇問題

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 餅乾同盒裝飲品就得喇，簡單啲

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 有冇杯㗎

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 杯喺廚房隔離個櫃，第三層

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 知道

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 講真，我覺得同你傾偈比同其他團友輕鬆啲，你唔好同佢哋講喎

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 哦哈哈好

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 好啦，今個禮拜你有冇咩事想大家代禱？

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 冇喎，下次先

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Sam，下週你可唔可以負責 snack？Lily 話佢 cover 唔到

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok 冇問題

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 買餅乾同飲品就得，唔使 fancy

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 咁個 rota 張表喺邊度睇？

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 我 send 個 link 畀你，等我搵下

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 好呀 thanks

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: [link]

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 收到，下下週都係我？

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 唔係，下下週係 Kenny。你嗰日個 test 點呀？

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok 啦，數學好難

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 辛苦曬。其實我覺得你 mature 過同齡嘅人，可以同你傾偈好舒服，呢句你唔好同其他人講

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: haha 好

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 咁我寫咗你 test 入 prayer board 喇，你 ok 嘅

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok 多謝
